recommendation: Keep this fix as-is; it removes a stale, semantically narrower "persisted to" phrase from an active operation source without changing later expansion-parameter refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-23565 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by Vocabulary. It asked that when a ValueSet expansion is created, the resulting ValueSet include the definition ValueSet.version when that element exists; the final resolution also carried ValueSet.status and used "SHALL be returned in" wording for the expansion resource.
initial_application: Commit ffdf5bcf1e0eed2f1d026c3b87eea4fc587146b7 partially applied the issue by changing source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml from "persisted to" to "returned in" and by updating expansion parameter prose. It did not update the parallel footer text in source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml.
additional_context: The ValueSet resource is active in source/fhir.ini and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand, so the operation definition is current build input. Confluence Vocab/VSE records support the Jira intent. Later ValueSet $expand parameter work such as FHIR-41589 and FHIR-46049 affects neighboring parameter descriptions but does not reverse the FHIR-23565 return requirement.
reconciliation: Updated source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml so the $expand operation footer says ValueSet.status and ValueSet.version SHALL be returned in the ValueSet resource instance containing the expansion, matching source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml and the Jira resolution.
source_changes: source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml: changed the $expand operation footer from "SHALL be persisted to" to "SHALL be returned in" for ValueSet.status and ValueSet.version copied from the definition to the expansion ValueSet.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 issue refined ValueSet.expansion.parameter documentation; it explains why current parameter-list prose should be preserved and does not alter the FHIR-23565 return rule.
Later R6 issue changed ValueSet $expand input parameter wording for dependent value set versions in the same operation definition, but it does not affect the returned ValueSet.version requirement.

evidence_items.summary: VSE discussion of naked expansions records the requirement that the resulting expansion ValueSet use the definition ValueSet.version when present and links the discussion to tracker 23565.
evidence_items.learned: The requirement is about the returned expansion resource's identity metadata, not only about persisted expansions.

evidence_items.summary: ValueSet is an active resource and its operations list references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand.

evidence_items.summary: The ValueSet expansion notes already say the status/version values SHALL be returned in the expansion ValueSet, and the operation footer is now aligned to that wording.
